it does not manage investment funds or portfolios."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Mainly long-only equity and fixed income boutiques sold through funds and intermediaries, not hedge fund, private equity or real asset strategies."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions on policies placed for businesses and individuals; no investment management."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Real asset and income strategies sold to institutions via funds and separate accounts, earning management and performance fees, overlapping GCM's real assets."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Retail-oriented mutual fund and ETF manager in traditional equity and fixed income, not alternatives for institutional investors."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Regulatory filing software and document services for public companies and funds, not investment management."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Research, ratings, data and software sold by subscription; portfolio management is a minor line, not its core business."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Private equity fund-of-funds, private credit and venture investing for family offices and institutions, earning management fees, closely matching GCM's strategies and clients."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Core business is investment processing software and outsourced operations for banks and institutions, not investing client capital."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Wealth management for high-net-worth individuals and families through separate accounts, not institutional alternative fund management."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Financial software and outsourced back-office operations for asset managers, not an asset manager itself."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Retail-focused mutual fund and separate account manager sold through advisers and broker-dealers, lacking GCM's alternatives focus."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"ETF sponsor and index licensor with tokenization products, primarily passive and retail-distributed rather than institutional alternatives."}]}
